svg.title: Aria 301_305 convergence; inset frame 1180
svg.desc: Measured mean PSNR on 539 fixed held-out views. Unsmoothened checkpoint curves. Insets show real intermediate maps at 600, 1000, 1300 Gaussian optimizer steps. Upper orange: VIGS-SLAM. Lower teal: Ours. Frozen causal tracker mapping-only comparison; late pose correction contributes to the jump.
